lines.t: There's a fire in the soul when a man chooses truth
And carrying weight that the world cannot see
He's called to be steady, to kneel before might
to lead by surrender to walk in the light raise up your house with wise gentle hands
lay pride to the ground let humility stand bold and resolved unwavering faith
He starts every morning to seek heaven's face
Guide your children with patience, discipline with care
Correct in compassion, always in prayer
Show them the way, both in struggle and rest
Never demanding, but giving your best
Turn to your wife with respect in your eyes
Cherish her spirit, never use lies
Serve her in weakness, protecting your strength
Speak hope and encouragement, go any length
Stand as a pillar, solid and true
Lead by example in all that you do
Order your house on unwavering stone
Follow the shepherd, never alone
In every decision, seek wisdom, not pride
Gather your household, listen, decide
Each voice is heard but your vision is clear
Submission to heaven brings order near
Shun harshness and anger, abandon all strife
Discipline gently, honor your wife
I apologize freely. Forgive every wrong. Restore what was broken. Make mercy your song.
A leader at work with his hands in the field. Integrity shining, his conscience unsealed.
With brothers and sisters, He carries their load
Never exalting Himself as a Lord
In the quietest moments, in the storms and the sun
He's found on his knees
When the battle is done
Repentance is refuge
Obedience is aim
Seeking the will of the one
Who calls him by name
Stand as a pillar
Solid and true
Led by example
In all that you do
Order your house on unwavering stone
Follow the shepherd, they're never alone
Treat those you cherish as sacred and rare
Your wife as a partner, your children as heirs
Lay selfish ambition at the foot of the tree
Show them in weakness, real strength can be free
You are a messenger, mercy your creed
Rule over your home by serving their need
When temptation to falter or dominate comes
Remember the cross and remember the Son
Stand as a pillar, solid and true
Led by example in all that you do
Order your house on unwavering stone
Model the shepherd, never alone
Alone in the household, in work, in faith and in love, a true man is always led from above.
